html:
Question 3

At the start of a study, a hive had 2000 bees. The study shows that the number of bees in the hive is expected to increase by 20% every month. What equation should be solved to determine the time that it will take for there to be 5000 bees in the hive?

a
 5000⋅(0.2)t=2000
b
 2000⋅(0.2)t=5000
c
 5000⋅(1.2)t=2000
d
 2000⋅(20)t=5000
e
 2000⋅(1.2)t=5000
